description: This file defines an interface IController for the WPEFramework project, specifically within the PluginHost namespace. The interface declares virtual methods for system control operations such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, and configuration management.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface representing control operations for plugins or devices, with methods for persistence, deletion, rebooting, environment and configuration management, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource specified by the path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment information based on an index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones configuration from a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
